evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, the env file is written at lines 347-348 before `image inspect`/`pull` at lines 362-372, and the temp env directory is only removed in the `finally` at lines 380-381. Thus the env file remains on disk during the pull, which can last up to `CONTAINER_PULL_TIMEOUT_MS`, contradicting the comment at lines 324-326 and unnecessarily extending the lifetime of the env contents. The proposed fix moves the write after the pull and before `create`, which is the correct behavior.
